estimates.assumptions: One medium red chilli weighs ~45g whole (edible portion after trimming stem is similar); matches supplied knownCaloriesPer100g for fresh chilli.
Pilchards in tomato sauce (canned, including sauce) typically ~180 kcal/100g; entire 425g can used as-is per recipe (edible, no draining).
Shaved Parmesan is a modest garnish for 4 servings (~5g per person); matches supplied knownCaloriesPer100g for hard Parmesan.
